description:
Cast Endless Swarm.
Endless Swarm is exiled with Eye of the Storm.
Choose to not cast your copy of Endless Swarm with Eye of the Storm.
Hive Mind triggers, and all other players are forced to cast Endless Swarm.
All other players may not cast any other spells for the rest of the game because of Endless Swarm's Epic ability, and all of their snakes die on ETB to Aether Flash.
